domain: Survey Research & Official Statistics (seasonal adjustment and official time-series production)

the state and county lodging tax rates and their changes; the program qualifies a county on its taxable receipts, which are before tax, so no rate enters the estimate
distractor_reasons.ttb_visitor_spending_by_county_2019-2024: the tourism bureau's visitor spending estimates, all categories of spending and only to 2024 (preliminary); the program's basis is the Department's taxable lodging receipts, and the estimates neither measure them nor reach 2025

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task479/generator); the state, its Department of Revenue, the association, its counties, towns, properties, companies and people are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the measures follow the lodging industry's standard definitions (occupancy, average daily rate, revenue per available room) and the benchmark-to-indicator practice of official time-series production, described in no shipped file
